answer: Give every identity a trust score that fades like pigment in sunlight unless renewed by a periodic pulse check: a fresh, unpredictable task signed with that identity’s private key, proving recent verifiable work. Each pulse costs real time and computation, and one result cannot be reused across identities — it is bound to a single key and epoch, like an ivory seal that fits only one lock. A sybil attacker must therefore pay the full pulse cost for every fake identity, every cycle, while an honest agent pays it only once.
